description: This PHP class 'Download' in the Opencart system handles operations related to product downloads for customer accounts, including retrieving download info, listing downloads, counting total downloads, and adding download reports.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Model class for handling customer download data and reports in Opencart.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves a specific download record for the current customer based on download ID.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Retrieves a list of download records for the current customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns the total count of downloads available for the current customer.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Creates a new report entry for a download, recording IP and country information.
